Starters.name: Chicken Satay
Starters.description: Chargrilled marinated chicken breast on bamboo skewers with homemade peanut sauce and cucumber pickles. *Contains nuts.

Starters.name: Golden Parcels
Starters.description: Minced pork and Thai herbs wrapped in rice pastry. Served with a sweet plum sauce.

Starters.name: Thai Dumplings
Starters.description: Steamed dumplings with a filling of minced pork and prawns in wonton pastry. Served with soy sauce and fried garlic.

Starters.name: Thai Fish Cakes
Starters.description: A blend of boneless fish, lime leaves, Thai red curry and peanuts. Served with sweet chilli sauce and cucumber pickles. *Contains nuts.

Starters.name: King Prawn Tempura
Starters.description: King prawns and vegetables coated in a light, crunchy batter. Served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Vegetable Tempura
Starters.description: Mixed vegetables coated in a light and crunchy batter. Served with sweet chilli suace.

Starters.name: Vegetarian Spring Rolls
Starters.description: Deep friend rice pastry spring rolls with a filling of stir-fried vegetables and vermicelli noodles. Served with a sweet plum sauce.

Starters.name: Thai Spring Rolls
Starters.description: Deep friend rice pastry spring rolls with a filling of Singapore Noodles and Pad Thai sauce. Served with sweet chilli suace.

Starters.name: Thai Kitti Platter for Min. Two (£13 Per Person)
Starters.description: A selection of our most popular appetisers, includes Chicken Satay, Golden Parcels, Vegetable Spring Rolls and Thai Fish Cakes. *Contains nuts.

Starters.name: Vegetarian Thai Kitti Platter for Min. Two (£12 Per Person)
Starters.description: A selection of our most popular vegetarian appetisers. Includes Vegetable Tempura, Thai Spring Rolls and Vegetable Spring Rolls.

Soups.name: Tom Yum
Soups.description: Thailand's famous hot soup with fresh chilli, coriander, lemongrass, mushrooms, kaffir and lime leaves.

Soups.name: Tom Kha
Soups.description: A very creamy and mild version of Tom Yum Soup, with the addition of coconut milk, mixed herbs, galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves.

Salad.name: Som Tam
Salad.description: A classic Thai salad with shredded papaya, carrots, cherry tomatoes, peanuts, Thai chillies and lime.

Curries.name: Green Curry
Curries.description: Thai Green Curry is a moderately spicy curry with a blend of Thai herbs, coconut milk, bamboo shoots, fine beans, red chillies and basil.

Curries.name: Red Curry
Curries.description: Spicy Thai Red Curry with coconut milk, bamboo shoots, green beans, lime leaves, chillies and basil.

Curries.name: Panang Curry
Curries.description: A mild, rich, and creamy Thai curry flavoured with coconut, finely shredded kaffir lime leaves and red chillies.

Curries.name: Massaman Curry
Curries.description: Meat of your choice, cooked in Massaman curry sauce with coconut milk, served with peanuts, potatoes and topped with fried onions and coriander. *Contains nuts.

Stir Fry.name: Stir Fry Cashew Nuts (Pad Med Ma Muang)
Stir Fry.description: Roasted cashew nuts stir-fried with your choice of meat, red and green peppers, spring onions and carrots. *Contains nuts.

Stir Fry.name: Sweet and Sour (Pad Prew Wan)
Stir Fry.description: Your choice of vegetable or meat stir-fried with a Thai style sweet and sour sauce, tomatoes, pineapple, cucumber and onions.

Stir Fry.name: Spicy Stir Fry (Pad Kra Pow)
Stir Fry.description: Spicy stir-fry mixed with your choice of vegetables or meat, fresh chillies, garlic, basil and fine beans.

Stir Fry.name: Stir Fry Mixed Vegetables
Stir Fry.description: Special mixed stir-fry vegetables with oyster sauce and your choice of meat (or just vegetables).

Noodles.name: Pad Thai
Noodles.description: Thailand's most popular dish. Stir fried rice noodles with egg, bean sprouts, spring onion and crushed peanuts. *Contains nuts.

Noodles.name: Pad Kee Mao
Noodles.description: Stir Fried rice noodles with fresh chillies, garlic, chilli oil and fresh basic.

Specials.name: Crispy Beef
Specials.description: Deep friend slices of rump steak, served with sweet chilli sauce and topped with coriander and long red chillies.

Specials.name: Crispy Chicken
Specials.description: Deep fried slices of chicken breast served with sweet chilli sauce. Topped with coriander, sesame seeds and long red chillies.

Specials.name: Chilli Fish
Specials.description: Deep fried sea bass fillet topped with sweet chilli sauce.

Specials.name: Aromatic Duck in Tamarind Suace
Specials.description: Marinated roast duck with crispy spring greens topped with tamarind sauce.

Specials.name: Pad Talay
Specials.description: Mixed seafood with chilli oil paste, green and red peppers, onions, mushrooms, spring onions and basil.

Specials.name: Tom Yum Hot Pot
Specials.description: Thailand's famous hot and sour soup with mixed seafood, lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, coriander, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms, spring onions and lime juice.

Specials.name: Goong Pow (BBQ Gian Prawns)
Specials.description: Grilled giant prawns with special Thai Kitti sauce.

Specials.name: Goong Ob Mor Din
Specials.description: Baked giant prawns with garlic, vermicelli noodles, mushrooms, ginger, onions and coriander, flavoured with a light soy sauce.

Specials.name: Weeping Tiger
Specials.description: Grilled sirloin steak on a bed of Pak (vegetables), served with a special Thai Kitti spicy sauce.

Rice.name: Coconut Rice
Rice.description: Steamed Jasmine rice cooked with coconut milk.

Rice.name: ★ Crab Fried Rice
Rice.description: Special fried rice with crab meat, spring onions and tomatoes.

Rice.name: ★ Pineapple Fried Rice
Rice.description: Special fried rice with seafood, peas, pineapple, carrots and spring onions.

Rice.name: ★ Mushroom Fried Rice
Rice.description: Special fried rice with mushrooms, carrots, onions and spring onions.

Rice.name: Plain Noodles
Rice.description: Stir fried rice noodles with eggs.

Set Menu.description: (for minimum of 2 people) includes: Vegetarian Mixed Starters, Tofu Massaman Curry, Tofu Ginger Stir Fry, Tofu Pad Thai, Steamed Rice.
